einzeiler: Testing Claude 5.1 live: building browser games and trying computer use features.
kurzfassung: The hosts go live shortly after the release of Anthropic's Claude 5.1 to test its new capabilities in real-time. They review the press release, pricing updates, and benchmark scores compared to previous models. Throughout the stream, they task the AI with building a browser game called Cat Doom, setting up Blender tools, and tackling various interactive challenges.
stichpunkte: Anthropic drops Claude 5.1, featuring Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 models.
Updates include a simplified flat caching price of 75 cents and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.
The new models show significant performance improvements on coding and scientific benchmarks.
Hosts test the AI's computer use feature by installing extensions and navigating the computer.
They build and play a browser-based game called Cat Doom using the model.
The AI creates 3D character models and visual representations of a solar system volcano theory based on chat prompts.

beschreibung:
Anthropic just released Claude Fable 5.1, its newest frontier model for long-running coding, research, and agentic work.

So naturally, we’re putting it to the test LIVE. 🤖

Early testing suggests Fable 5.1 is faster, easier to work with, and capable of handling massive coding projects, long-form writing, and autonomous agent tasks more efficiently. Every even found that it used less than half as many tokens as Opus 5 in one internal test.

But it has some quirks too. It can blow past word counts, create unnecessary subagents, and occasionally keep working when you tell it to stop.

Today, Grant and Corey from The Neuron are testing those claims for themselves.

We’re putting Fable 5.1 through:

🧠 Complex research and knowledge work
💻 Coding and long-running agent workflows
✍️ Writing, editing, and instruction following
🤖 Autonomous tasks where Claude runs on its own
🛑 Constraint, budget, and STOP tests
🆚 Whatever else the live chat wants us to try

Anthropic also cut cached-input pricing by 75%, potentially making long-running Claude agents significantly cheaper to operate.

Can Fable 5.1 actually become the model you hand a giant task and walk away from?

Let’s find out live.
